original_test_intent: Validate the power-distribution board's management-I2C path and expected rail/channel monitoring devices while leaving power distribution and protection state unchanged.
original_method: Once the owner supplies PDB revision, rail/channel/load topology, controller/mux route, safe telemetry/status reads and expected ranges, collect bounded responses and correlate them with whole-platform power and thermal health.
manual_activity: The power-distribution owner maps PDB channels to rails, supplies scaling and limits, approves read-only status/telemetry access and declares any separate physical inspection with qualified electrical controls.
required_inputs: BMC/OOB controller, mux and bus route
Units, scaling, sampling and acceptable ranges
Explicit exclusions for rail enable, margin, reset, latch-clear and protection writes
Independent power/management recovery and abort thresholds
safety_requirements: Do not infer PDB disassembly, isolation or continuity measurement
Do not scan unknown power-management buses
Do not issue rail enable/disable, margining, protection, latch-clear, reset or configuration writes
Do not disturb redundancy or active load feeds
Preserve fault latches and SEL evidence
Stop on rail deviation, current surge, device loss, bus lock, power/thermal event or BMC reachability loss
agent_execution_scope: Validate BMC route, read allowlist, units and ranges
Correlate every channel with its rail and load
Perform no physical or power-control action
engineer_actions: Approve read registers, scaling and limits
Provide independent recovery and any physical procedure

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command exists; its conservative refusal is valid, but the Master does not define a physical continuity operation. Conditional management evidence requires an exact PDB rail and read-register contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through the approved BMC/OOB route, read only mapped PDB identity, status and telemetry fields with documented scaling, preserving raw values and verifying no rail or protection state changes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PDB_BD, the two TBD fields and two-minute planning estimates remain unchanged; no controller, rail, address, register, value or isolation state is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES PDB I2C PACKAGE AND CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Fingerprint the PDB and rail topology, capture baseline faults and telemetry, read allowlisted monitor/controller values through the documented mux route, decode units/scaling against project limits, and prove rail, redundancy, BMC and thermal state remain stable.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Provides a conditional logical evidence model without rewriting the source or authorizing electrical work.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Management telemetry covers the approved PDB monitor path, not busbar/connector mechanics, insulation, signal integrity or offline continuity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A mistaken control register can disable or margin a rail, clear a diagnostic latch or interrupt multiple platform loads at once.

project_override_considerations: Any physical PDB measurement or isolation stage must be separately approved with electrical limits and personnel. Logical reads cannot prove physical integrity, and physical inspection cannot prove channel scaling or management responses.
expected_evidence: Exact PDB_BD source and project applicability
Complete raw identity, status and telemetry values
Decoded values with units/scaling and expected-range comparison
Before/after rails, redundancy, faults, SEL/SDR, BMC and thermal health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row is underspecified by matching TBD fields, not internally contradictory. Physical-continuity requirements originate only in prior review text.

blocked_analysis.analysis: PDB management identity/status/telemetry reads are a definable safe operation class. Exact topology, scaling, ranges and route are project inputs, allowing a deterministic plan under ED-04.

review_improvement: Replaces the inferred manual-only test with a rail-aware, read-only PDB management contract and makes high-blast-radius control/latch registers explicit exclusions.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PDB can expose multiple rails and controllers behind one mux, so a response without channel-to-rail mapping may be correct electrically yet assigned to the wrong load. The engineering proof is raw-to-scaled telemetry tied to the real rail topology plus unchanged protection state. That is automatable after approval and distinct from any physical continuity work.
